candidates.title: Compute the 3x3 and 5x5 box sums from shared shifted loads
candidates.application: sgr_box35_row_h loads each source position once (or slides) and forms both the 3-wide and 5-wide sums: the center 3-taps of the 5-tap sum are the 3x3 sum
candidates.expected_gain: halves the horizontal pass memory traffic vs two separate box functions

candidates.title: x_by_x lookup by an indexed load or an in-register gather
candidates.application: z is at most 255 for both tracks: vluxei8 from dav1d_sgr_x_by_x, or the 256-byte table in an LMUL-4 group with vrgather.vv; both weight tracks share the same table
candidates.expected_gain: one table load serves both weight tracks
preconditions: indices clamped to 0..255 before the lookup

candidates.title: p*s with the C's 32-bit wrap, twice

candidates.expected_gain: one weight pass feeds both finish filters
